scope: Steam co-op wave survival, roguelite and mission-based PvE first released from 28 September 2023 to 28 September 2026, with a separate single-player FPS comparison sample. Early Access starts the clock. Older Early Access games that reached 1.0 in this window remain visible as context.
coverageNote: Broad manual screening, not a complete Steam census. We retrieved 500 rows across five pages of Steam’s FPS + Co-op tag search, sorted by release date, reaching beyond the three-year cutoff; tags contain false positives and can omit relevant or delisted games. Individual Steam/SteamDB checks and developer sources supplement that search. The solo comparison is selected, not a market-wide control group. Indie ownership remains provisional where only credits are available.

methodology.summary: Steam reviews and prices are observed snapshots. Revenue is an editorial sensitivity scenario, not reported sales or a Gamalytic/VGI estimate. Success here means review reach and sentiment; development cost, marketing spend and profit are unknown.
methodology.formula: Steam-purchase reviews × 20–60 assumed copies per review × current US base price × 40–80% assumed average selling-price factor.
limitations: The 20–60 and 40–80% bands are editorial assumptions, not fitted confidence intervals. Actual revenue can fall outside them. Reviews per buyer vary by audience, genre, price, promotions and age.

Gross base-game consumer spend in USD, before store fees, tax and refunds; excludes DLC, in-app purchases, keys sold elsewhere, other stores and consoles. No historical regional-price or discount ledger is available. The current base price is only a proxy.

Steam-purchase reviews feed the revenue scenario; reach and sentiment use all-language, all-purchase reviews with off-topic filtering on. Neither count is verified sales. Zero reviews, unavailable prices and free-to-play games have no revenue estimate.

Category medians are unweighted per-game values; revenue medians include only estimable paid titles and display that denominator. Cohorts are selected, unequal in size and age; median age is shown. No causal effect, market-wide hit rate or probability of success is inferred.
Lifetime reviews are not current momentum. A single concurrent-player snapshot is not retention, a daily peak or an all-time peak. Titles younger than 30 days are marked Early read.

Editorial reach labels: under 100 all-purchase reviews = Limited reach; 100–999 = Growing; 1,000–9,999 = Established; 10,000+ = Large audience. These labels never mean profitable. Sentiment from tiny samples is unstable.
Games with a known free-to-paid transition can be excluded from revenue estimation even when a current price exists; read the per-game explanation. Mixed-mode app metrics cannot isolate a PvE mode.
